title: •Chewie’s AT-ST
caption: •Chewie’s AT-ST (V)
game_text: May add 2 pilots. During battle, if Chewie aboard, may target an opponent’s character or AT-ST present. Draw destiny. Target hit and power = 0 if destiny > defense value. Immune to attrition < 4.
lore: Enclosed. Chewie’s daring capture of an Imperial AT-ST helped turn the tide in the Battle of Endor.

notes: Unique (•); curly apostrophe in the slip's heading and caption (Chewie’s). Scomp-link ring at the top-left of the text box → scomp true. Empty icon column (only the set sphere). Stats POWER 3 / ARMOR 4 / LANDSPEED 3, deploy 2 / forfeit 5 (same as printed). Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. Slip text matches the stub. Lore corrected from the scan (and the VB3 remake): 'Enclosed.' has a period (wiki 'Enclosed Chewie's') and Chewie’s takes a curly apostrophe. 'Enclosed' is not visibly bold on the 350 px scan or the 350 px VB3 remake — left plain (Blizzard Scout 1 prints it bold; may be worth checking on a better scan). Base scan only 350 px; copyright Endor line, 1999. Modern: VB3-L-chewiesatst-pre.gif (350 px); no V<N> remake.
